sources.title: Xuweiyi Chen | University of Virginia
sources.snippet: I was a member of SLED lab. I obtained my bachelor's degree in Applied and Computational Mathematics Science at the University of Washington where I worked with Prof. Yunhe feng on Responsible AI. Research Interests My research centers on scalable approaches to 3D computer vision, language-grounded robotics, and visual world models.

sources.title: Xuweiyi Chen | alphaXiv
sources.snippet: Xuweiyi Chen co-created LLM-Grounder, which uses LLMs as agents to identify 3D objects through natural language. Chen is a PhD student at the University of Virginia advised by Zezhou Cheng. His research centers on 3D CV and NLP, specifically 3D/4D foundation models and grounding language for robotic agents. He also co-authored Multi-Object Hallucination to analyze errors in vision-language ...
